title: 第七十一章致命的手段第七十章我答应
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 大殿里的压迫感瞬间散去。
顾长风坐回太师椅，端起几案上的茶盏，吹了吹上面漂浮的茶叶。
“算你识相。”
“马得水那蠢货搞出来的烂摊子，本座会收拾。他那三个栽赃的废物手下，会在水牢里多待些时日。”
顾长风喝了一口茶，语气平淡得没有丝毫起伏。
“至于你的卷宗，明早就会出现在外门执事堂的桌子上。”
“上面会写得清清楚楚，废阁杂役叶凡，因私藏违禁血丹被查，畏罪潜逃，下落不明。”
叶凡低着头，接上了话茬。
“这么一来，内门赵乾坤那帮人就算想找麻烦，也找不到由头了。长老好算计。”
顾长风放下茶盏，瓷器碰撞发出清脆的响声。
“这只是第一步。”
“你既然要混进黑风谷，就不能带半点天剑宗的影子。”
“你那几手粗浅的拳脚功夫，到了外面少用，散修有散修的活法，你去了那边，自己把皮绷紧点。”
叶凡抬起头，脸上堆起讨好的笑。
“长老，晚辈去那种魔门窝子，九死一生。”
“您老人家指头缝里随便漏点东西，也够晚辈保命了，总不能让晚辈光着膀子去查案吧？”
顾长风看着台下这个顺杆爬的杂役，发出一声冷哼。
“保命的东西，自然会给你。”
话音刚落。
顾长风突然抬起右手。
枯瘦的食指和中指并拢，对着叶凡的方向轻轻一点。
没有任何征兆。
一道幽蓝色的灵光从顾长风指尖迸发，速度快到了极点。
叶凡根本来不及做出任何反应，甚至连躲避的念头都没生出来。
那道幽蓝灵光直接撞碎了叶凡胸前的衣襟，狠狠扎进他的皮肉里。
叶凡闷哼出声。
心脏骤然收缩。
一股透骨的寒意顺着胸口直接钻进心脉，瞬间锁死了周围的血管。
剧痛。
无法形容的剧痛。
叶凡浑身的肌肉瞬间绷紧。
他四转锻体五阶的强悍肉身感受到了外来异物的入侵，气血本能地开始疯狂反扑。
赤红色的灵气在经脉深处剧烈翻腾，试图将那道幽蓝色的寒气强行逼出去。
骨骼发出令人牙酸的咔咔声。
叶凡双腿一软，“扑通”一声单膝跪在青石板上。
他双手死死捂住胸口，十指在衣服上抓出深深的褶皱。

The sense of oppression in the hall instantly dissipated.
Gu Changfeng sat back on the master's chair, picked up the tea cup on the table, and blew the tea leaves floating on it.
"You know the truth."
"I will clean up the mess caused by that idiot Ma Deshui. His three framed losers will stay in the water prison for a longer time."
Gu Changfeng took a sip of tea and his tone was calm without any fluctuation.
"As for your file, it will appear on the table in the outer deacon hall tomorrow morning."
"It will be written clearly on it. Ye Fan, the handyman of Feige, was investigated for hiding prohibited blood pills. He absconded in fear of crime and his whereabouts are unknown."
Ye Fan lowered his head and continued the conversation.
"In this way, even if the inner sect Zhao Qiankun and his gang want to cause trouble, they will not be able to find a reason. The elder is very scheming."
Gu Changfeng put down the tea cup, and the porcelain made a crisp sound when it collided.
"This is just the first step."
"Since you want to sneak into Black Wind Valley, you can't bring any trace of Tianjian Sect with you."
"Don't use your crude fist and kick skills outside. Rogue cultivators have their own way of living. When you go over there, tighten your skin yourself."
Ye Fan raised his head with a flattering smile on his face.
"Elder, if you go to that kind of demon den, you will have a narrow escape from death."
"If you, the old man, just slip something out of your fingers, it's enough to save this junior's life. You can't let this junior go to investigate the case shirtless, right?"
Gu Changfeng looked at the handyman in the audience and let out a cold snort.
"Whatever is needed to save your life will naturally be given to you."
The words just fell.
Gu Changfeng suddenly raised his right hand.
The skinny index finger and middle finger came together and tapped lightly in Mark's direction.
There are no signs.
A faint blue light burst out from Gu Changfeng's fingertips at extremely fast speed.
Ye Fan had no time to react at all, and he didn't even have the idea of ​​​​evading.
The faint blue light directly smashed into pieces of Ye Fan's chest and pierced into his flesh.
"Ugh!"
Ye Fan groaned.
The heart contracts suddenly.
A bone-chilling chill ran down his chest and penetrated directly into his heart, instantly locking the surrounding blood vessels.
Severe pain.
Indescribable pain.
Ye Fan's muscles all over his body tensed instantly.
His powerful physical body, which was at the fourth level of the fourth-level forging, felt the invasion of foreign objects, and his energy and blood instinctively began to fight back crazily.
The crimson spiritual energy was violently churning in the depths of the meridians, trying to force out the blue cold air.
The bones made a heart-wrenching clicking sound.
Ye Fan's legs softened and he knelt on one knee on the bluestone with a "plop".
He covered his chest with both hands, and his fingers dug deep wrinkles into his clothes.
